description: Medicare IRMAA calculator (2026 + 2027) — Medicare Part B and Part D income-related surcharge (IRMAA) from official CMS tables for 2026 and 2027: tier, Part B total premium, Part D add-on, annual and household cost, distance to the next cliff, how much MAGI cut drops a tier and what it saves, Part A/B deductibles. Params: magi= (from the tax return 2 years earlier; or agi= + tax_exempt_interest=), filing=single|joint|mfs, year=2027 (default) or 2026, part_d=true|false, both_enrolled=true|false (joint). Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
